metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: QURMUN crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C186 H216 Dy18 N15 O111 Zn12 3+,12(C1 H4 O1),3(N1 O3 1-),5(H2 O1). (Dy) has 0 O neighbors; Dy12? (Dy) has 0 O neighbors; Zn7? (Zn) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 60 pairs, 4 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.415-4.342 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 85.14-149.59°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Zn12Dy18(OH)30(L)12(sal)6(OAc)6(NO3)3(H2O)6](NO3)3·12MeOH·5H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 30 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(I), I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
